package.name: odri_five_bar_force_velocity_py
package.description: Python endpoint force-to-velocity controller (qdot = J^T f_c) for the odri_dual_motor_testbed five-bar mechanism. Drives the joints through the odri_forward_command_controller ~/commands topic, using an analytical (closed-form) Jacobian derived from the URDF geometry -- no Pinocchio or other rigid-body library involved.
